name: plain
description: Work in your Plain workspace from ChatGPT: triage and reply to threads, report on your queue, update accounts, and turn Knowledge Gaps into help center articles.

interface.longDescription:
Plain is AI support infrastructure for B2B teams. Your customers reach you in Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, email, and chat, and Plain brings every one of those conversations into one workspace. This plugin lets ChatGPT read and act in that workspace, so you can triage, reply, investigate, and report without leaving your conversation with ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Triage threads: search and read conversations, assign them, set priority, apply labels, and snooze or close them
- Reply to customers on the channel they wrote in (email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, or chat), and leave internal notes for your team
- Ask Sidekick Agent to investigate a thread across your connected tools
- Report on your queue: thread volume and trends over time, filtered and grouped the way you need
- Look up and update customers and accounts, and add events to a customer's timeline
- Find Knowledge Gaps, the questions your Customer Agent couldn't answer, and write or update help center articles to fill them
- Link threads to issues in Linear and other issue trackers
- Inspect and manage workflows

Use cases:
- Catch up on the queue: "What's urgent and unassigned right now? Group it by account and assign anything from Enterprise-tier accounts to me."
- Prepare for a customer call: "I have a renewal call with Acme tomorrow. Summarize every thread they've opened in the last 90 days, what's still open, and which Linear issues are linked."
- Close gaps in your help center: "Show me this month's top Knowledge Gaps and draft help center articles for the top three."

A Plain workspace is required. For support, email help@plain.com.

defaultPrompt: What's urgent and unassigned right now? Group it by account and assign anything from Enterprise-tier accounts to me.
I have a renewal call with Acme tomorrow. Summarize their last 90 days of threads, what's open, and any linked Linear issues.
Show me this month's top Knowledge Gaps and draft help center articles for the top three.

positive.prompt: Find open urgent threads about invoice exports.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with status TODO and priority 0 (urgent), then return the matching threads with their titles and status.
Find the customer, read their timeline and summarize recent chat messages, notes and events without inventing details.

positive.prompt: Add an internal note on the thread about invoice export timeouts saying the customer asked for a call next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the thread, create a note on it using the thread's customer ID and confirm it was added. The note is visible only to the team and nothing is sent to the customer.

positive.prompt: Reply to Priya Shah's chat thread about setting up SSO saying we will send the setup guide today.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the chat thread, post the reply on it and confirm it was sent. The reply appears as a chat message on the thread and no email is sent.

positive.prompt: Draft a help center article from the resolved thread about invoice exports.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the thread with status DONE, look up the help center ID and generate an article from the thread. The article has DRAFT status and nothing is published.

negative.expected_behavior: Plain has no refund or customer payment tool. Explain that Plain cannot process this refund and make no changes.

negative.prompt: Show me the threads in workspace w_01M00000000000000000000000.
negative.expected_behavior: Report no access and return no data. The connection only reaches the signed-in workspace, and the workspace tool returns FORBIDDEN for any other ID.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London today?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Plain tools for this request.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with almost full Plain API coverage, including threads, customers and accounts, reporting, Knowledge Gaps, help center articles, issue links, and workflows.
